name: Exterior Soffit Protection & Setup
intent: Ground protection below soffit drip zone, fixture masking (EA with 2-5 per elevation heuristic), fascia junction masking (LF), equipment setup by method.
doctrine: Soffit protection. Landscape/hardscape ground protection below drip zone (critical for overhead — gravity pulls all drips straight down). Fixture masking 10 EA/hr with 2-5 per elevation heuristic. Fascia junction tape+film at 120 LF/hr (only when fascia already finished, skip in top-down NC sequence). Equipment setup at global rates: brush 5 min, spray 12 min. Height factor modifier applies to soffit/fascia work.
